info.headline: Severe Weather Warning for North East Pastoral, Flinders and Mid North forecast districts
info.description:
DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 75 km/h with peak gusts of around 110 km/h are likely about the higher parts of the Flinders Ranges. Conditions are forecast to ease by around sunrise on Monday morning. Locations which may be affected include Hawker, Arkaroola and Peterborough.
Severe weather is no longer occurring in the West Coast, Eastern Eyre Peninsula, Yorke Peninsula and North West Pastoral districts and the warning for these districts is CANCELLED.
info.instruction: The State Emergency Service advises that people should: * Move vehicles under cover or away from trees; * Secure or put away loose items around your property. * Stay indoors, away from windows, while conditions are severe.
